description: MediaMath mobile in-app pixels on pixel.mathtag.com/event/mob. MediaMath documents mt_adid, mt_id, mt_uuid, and mt_idt on the native URL. Browser /event/js and /event/img stay vendor/mediamath. Cookie sync on sync.mathtag.com is not contracted.

params.name: mt_id
params.description: It is the TerminalOne Pixel ID. MediaMath documents mt_id as required on /event/mob.
params.fix_hint: Set mt_id to the Pixel ID from the MathTag on the website.

params.name: mt_adid
params.description: It is the TerminalOne Advertiser ID. MediaMath documents mt_adid as required on /event/mob.
params.fix_hint: Set mt_adid to the Advertiser ID from the MathTag on the website.

params.name: mt_uuid
params.description: It is the device advertising ID. MediaMath documents mt_uuid on every native /event/mob URL. Use a random UUID when Limit Ad Tracking is on.
params.fix_hint: Send the IDFA, AAID, or Windows Advertising ID as mt_uuid. Randomize it when Limit Ad Tracking is enabled.

params.name: mt_idt
params.description: It is the advertising-ID type. MediaMath documents idfa on iOS, aaid on Android, and waid on Windows.
params.fix_hint: Set mt_idt=idfa, aaid, or waid to match the OS that minted mt_uuid.

params.name: mt_exem
params.description: It is a SHA-256 hashed email for MediaMath ConnectedID. MediaMath documents that hashing is not performed by the pixel.
params.fix_hint: Hash the email with SHA-256 and send the hex digest as mt_exem.

params.name: mt_excl
params.description: It is a SHA-256 hashed account ID for MediaMath ConnectedID.
params.fix_hint: Hash the account ID with SHA-256 and send the hex digest as mt_excl.

rules.message: A parameter carries what looks like a raw email address. MediaMath documents mt_exem as a SHA-256 digest and says personally identifiable information must not be sent.
rules.fix_hint: Hash the email with SHA-256 and send it as mt_exem.
